caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular mosaic design positioned at an angle to show perspective. The mosaic is bordered by a green outer frame made up of small, evenly spaced square tiles. Inside this green border lies a decorative band rendered in primarily white tiles, interspersed with intricate patterns in blue, red, yellow, and green. These patterns include swirling shapes, scrolling foliage, and geometric motifs that run parallel to the edges of the rectangle. The innermost section of the mosaic consists of a wide, empty rectangular field filled with closely packed, light grey or off-white tiles. The overall composition is symmetrical, with repeating patterns on each side and a strong sense of order in the layout of the tilework. The background of the drawing is plain and light-colored, providing no additional objects or decorations.
title: Marble Mosaic Floor
